trustAssertions.bearerForm: exact single Bearer token with no whitespace and a 4096-character bound
trustAssertions.cursor: checksum plus tenant/workspace scope and route kind
trustAssertions.errors: bounded normalized public code/message/path without provider text reflection
trustAssertions.portability: Web APIs only in reviewed API/auth/report boundary
trustAssertions.execution: read-only public routes; no submitted-project or credential-derived execution authority

observedDefect.impact: A malformed, accessor-bearing, cyclic, or oversized cross-tenant report row could change an authorized tenant's empty 200 response to a provider-contract 500.
observedDefect.repair: Hostile-safe shallow container and tenant/workspace descriptor inspection now filters cross-scope rows before authoritative full report validation.

residualRisks: Stage B has not tested an assembled candidate.
Provider snapshotVersion is validated but is not currently incorporated into report cursor identity; Worker 2 must test snapshot drift in the assembled integration.
A hidden record whose tenant/workspace identity itself is malformed remains a provider-contract failure because its scope cannot be safely determined; this is deliberate fail-closed behavior.
Full dependency-backed repository and Cloudflare runtime tests remain Worker 2/Round 5 gates.
